::: {#sol-scores-to-probabilities}

Apply the [softmax function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax):
exponentiate each number, which makes it positive,
then divide by the sum of the exponentials, which makes them add up to 1.

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
probabilities = torch.softmax(scores, dim=1)
print(probabilities.detach().numpy().round(3))
print(probabilities.sum(dim=1))
```

`dim=1` applies softmax across the 10 numbers in each row, one row per image.
Each row of probabilities adds up to 1,
and each is near $\frac{1}{10}$, since the network is untrained.
The output layer with softmax on top is a [multinomial logistic regression](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-multinomial-logistic-regression)
whose inputs are the 32 values of the [hidden layer](#def-hidden-layer).

:::
